images.title: How much longer is 285 cm than 2 m 60 cm
images.purpose: Show the difference of two lengths as the gap between two bars on one tape: 285 cm and 2 m 60 cm, a gap of 25 cm.
images.composition: A tape in cm, two bars (teal 285 cm, amber 2 m 60 cm which is 260 cm) and a bracket for the gap.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. TAPE: one horizontal line from x 200 to x 1250 at y 560 (1 cm is 3.5 px, so 300 cm is 1050 px) with exactly 7 tall tick marks (40 px) at x 200, 375, 550, 725, 900, 1075 and 1250, labelled below in 36 px 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250 and 300, and the unit cm at the right end, x 1310, y 560. BAR 1 (top): one teal #0072B2 rectangle 997 px long and 70 px high (x 200 to 1197, y 200 to 270) with the label Sonu's stole 285 cm inside it in white 40 px. BAR 2 (below): one amber #E69F00 rectangle 910 px long and 70 px high (x 200 to 1110, y 310 to 380) with the label Shikha's stole 2 m 60 cm = 260 cm inside it in dark 40 px. GAP: one reddish purple #CC79A7 bracket, a horizontal line 87 px long (x 1110 to 1197) at y 420 with a short vertical end stroke (30 px) at each end, and the label 25 cm below it in 48 px bold (x 1153, y 470). Two thin grey #6B7280 vertical lines from the bar ends down to y 420 at x 1110 and x 1197. In all: 1 tape, 2 bars, 1 bracket. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a gap label other than 25 cm
images.takeaway: The difference is the longer length minus the shorter length in the same unit.
images.description: Two bars on one tape, 285 cm and 2 m 60 cm which is 260 cm, with the gap of 25 cm marked.
images.context: Concept image for How Much Longer? The Difference of Two Lengths. It follows the idea of the tall statues in your maths book (the difference of two heights) and shows the concept's own example, 285 cm and 2 m 60 cm (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Let the student see the gap before the subtraction is said. The slip to watch: subtracting 285 − 2 − 60.
